messages:
alex-m: just got a repo-scan hit — looks like a long lived Redwood API key in a public gist: https://gist.github.com/abcd1234 :rotating_light:
eng-sec-bot: Repo-scan matched rule leaked-credential-2026, severity=high, indicator=redwood_api_key, evidence=snippet attached
simon: which env is that key scoped to?
alex-m: appears to be the ingest service key (prod). key prefix `sk-` and last used by ingest-worker-prod.
oncall-sre: pausing ingest workers in us-west-2 and diverting traffic to fallback pool now — ETA 2m.
lisa: starting rotation flow, will rotate the key and then invalidate the old one. tagging @simon for audit trail checks.
alex-m: command I ran locally: ```rwctl secrets rotate --service ingest --key sk-abc123 --reason "gist exposure"```
eng-sec-bot: Rotation job queued, job-id job_2026_00123, awaiting confirmation of revoke.
simon: I revoked sk-abc123 in the admin console and deleted it from the secrets store. Confirmed 12 API calls in the past 24h from 3 distinct IPs; flagged for suspicious access.
lisa: doing a quick blast-radius check: running logs query to enumerate requests that used that key and checking for customer-identifying params.
alex-m: noted. can we also invalidate any derived caches that might leak data?
oncall-sre: cache purge started for ingest routing keys. fallback pool stable. no 5xx surge.
simon: pulled last 7 days of usage, looks like internal CICD used it 3 times (mistaken commit), and two client integrations used it (unauthorized). opening support tickets for those clients to check scope.
lisa: legal notified, prepping external disclosure template. For now we consider this an internal incident until we confirm customer data access.
eng-sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042. Priority: P2. Owner: simon. SLA for postmortem: 72h.
alex-m: post-rotation checklist: 1) confirm revoke 2) rotate any dependent keys 3) update service config 4) run key-scan across repos to find other secrets 5) short TTLs for new keys.
simon: adding actions: enable KMS envelope encryption for secrets store, add CloudTrail alert for any new key creation, and require MFA for key creation in IAM.
lisa: RBAC change proposal: only `service-ops` role can create ingest keys, existing IAM policy change landed in `tf` branch, will run `terraform apply` after approvals.
oncall-sre: applied RBAC patch in staging and rolled out to prod with zero-downtime. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/p/r/7890
alex-m: also suggesting we add a pre-commit hook + CI job that fails if `sk-` pattern is present, and periodic secret-scan in scheduled CI.
simon: will own postmortem writeup and timeline. action items assigned: rotate all service keys (simon), add repo precommit + CI scan (alex-m), RBAC enforcement + TF review (lisa), KMS audit logging & CloudTrail alerts (simon).
lisa: I'll draft the partner comms and coordinate with support if any customers are impacted.
eng-sec-bot: Reminder: attach evidence clipped from gist and redacted logs to the incident ticket.
alex-m: quick note — no PII visible in the snippets we pulled, but still doing a deeper scan.
simon: will post the remediation PR and timeline in this thread when ready.
lisa: thanks everyone for the quick response. please add any missed items to INC-2026-042 and ping #product-security once postmortem is ready :thumbsup:
